orders_queue_format_chk.name: orders_queue_format_chk
orders_queue_format_chk.value: "orders"."queue_number" IS NULL OR (char_length(btrim("orders"."queue_number")) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "orders"."queue_number" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

orders_ready_chk.name: orders_ready_chk
orders_ready_chk.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('READY', 'DONE') OR ("orders"."queue_number" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."proof_image_path" IS NOT NULL)

payment_accounts_dest_chk.name: payment_accounts_dest_chk
payment_accounts_dest_chk.value: ("payment_accounts"."type" = 'QRIS_STATIC' AND "payment_accounts"."qris_image_path" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_accounts"."type" <> 'QRIS_STATIC' AND "payment_accounts"."account_no" IS NOT NULL)

payments_proof_chk.name: payments_proof_chk
payments_proof_chk.value: "payments"."status"::text NOT IN ('PROOF_SENT', 'VERIFYING') OR ("payments"."proof_image_path" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."proof_claimed_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_verified_partner_chk.name: payments_verified_partner_chk
payments_verified_partner_chk.value: "payments"."status" <> 'VERIFIED' OR ("payments"."partner_company_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."partner_amount" IS NOT NULL)
